notes.subject: תחת ×4
notes.rationale: Go boela ga 'go e na le' ga nne ga dipoelo tša tlhaelele — kgopolo ya go fapoga ga boemo e boutšwa ka mokgwa wa ka ntle

notes.subject: נקפה
notes.rationale: Lentšu le tlhagelela fela mo go Tanakh; go ka ba thapo ya go khwaša

notes.subject: כי
notes.rationale: Ba bangwe ba bašwa ba re ke leswao la go fišwa (branding), ba bangwe ba re ke 'ka gobane' — modu wa Seheberu o letla ga bobedi

notes.subject: פתיגיל
notes.rationale: Go ka ba seaparo sa mehla ya dihlahla se se na le diswantšho; le tlhagelela fela mo Genesi 41:42 le mo

notes.subject: go tla ba
notes.rationale: Sepedi se nyaka lehlodi la nakong; Seheberu se šomiša היה ka go boela ga lona ga bobedi go gatelela

translation: Gomme go tla ba gore, go e na le monko o monate go tla ba go bola; gomme go e na le khware go tla ba thapo; gomme go e na le moriri o o logilwego go tla ba go hlwa ga moriri; gomme go e na le seaparo se se ntle go tla ba go ikhwara ka saka sa go lla; leswao la go fišwa go e na le botee.
